def array_reference
  {T : Type} (N : Std.Usize) (coremarkerCopyInst : core.marker.Copy T)
  (v : Slice T) (zero : T) :
  Result (Option (Array T N))
  := do
  let i := Slice.len v
  if i != N
  then ok none
  else
    let out := Array.repeat N zero
    let out1 ← array_reference_loop v out 0#usize
    ok (some out1)

def array_slice_result_reference
  {T : Type} (N : Std.Usize) (coremarkerCopyInst : core.marker.Copy T)
  (v : Slice T) (zero : T) :
  Result (core.result.Result (Array T N) (alloc.vec.Vec T))
